brief:
Jerusalem Electricity Company announced it will cut power to parts of the Al-Masayef area in Ramallah city, the Ma'an news agency reported. The company cited the need to improve service quality, ensure stable and safe electricity supply, and develop infrastructure as reasons for the outage.

The company expressed regret over the necessity of the power cuts while pursuing these improvements to its network.

title: Jerusalem Electricity Company cuts power to Ramallah district for infrastructure upgrades
